senses.gloss:
† व्री व्री, ii. 9, व्री̆णा, व्री̆णी, Par. To choose.
 --i. 4, Ātm. To be chosen.

व्रीड् व्रीड्, i. 4, Par.
 1. To be, or grow bashful, Vikr. 8, 17.
 2. † To throw.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वृडित (perhaps rather वॄडा + इत), Ashamed, modest, Chr. 56, 18.

व्रीड व्रीड (m. and) f. डा,
 1. Shame, Rājat. 5, 338.
 2. Bashfulness, Bhartṛ. 2, 18.
 --Comp.
व्रीहि व्रीहि (probably derived from वृध्), m. Rice, Pañc. 167, 1 (pl. grains of rice).
